title: desktopApprovalNotifications
responsibility: Locates the packaged Mac approval helper and starts an account watcher that can show an operating-system notification.

inputs.name: refreshAccountInBackground.auth
inputs.description: The desktop account service, when configured.

inputs.name: refreshAccountInBackground.currentWindow
inputs.description: Returns the currently open app window so a notification click can focus it.

outputs.name: packagedApprovalHelper
outputs.description: The absolute path of the bundled helper for a packaged macOS app, otherwise undefined.

outputs.name: refreshAccountInBackground
outputs.description: Unreferenced background refresh timer for the configured account, otherwise undefined.
